publicInstruction: Decide the stated authorization scenario at the declared entry from supplied fixed source and accepted policy. Treat premises as assumptions, cite exact supplied-source locations for the control and effect, preserve decisive unknowns, and do not execute the target or infer deployment facts.

publicBrief.acceptedPolicy: A download must pass the owner-aware view_document check on the root document before serving any selected file version.
publicBrief.currentQuestion: At DocumentViewSet.download handler entry, can an authenticated user download a requested version document they own when its root document is owned by someone else and they lack an object view grant on that root? Assume the user has the required global view permission and the documents exist.
premises: At download entry, the authenticated caller has global document view permission and owns the requested version, but a different user owns the existing root document and the caller has no object view grant on that root.
requiredResponseDetails: Identify which object is checked and which file object would be served; do not collapse version ownership into root authorization.

results.explanation: At the declared-entry boundary, the handler visibly delegates to file_response(pk, request, "attachment") and catches only specified errors. The supplied entry does not show which object the authorization check examines, whether the requested version or its root is bound to that check, or which file object file_response serves. Therefore the stated premises distinguish version ownership from root authorization, but they do not establish an observed allow or deny at this boundary. The accepted policy requires an owner-aware view_document check on the root before serving any selected version; compliance with that policy cannot be determined from this entry alone.

entry.statement: The download action receives the request and requested primary-key value at handler entry.

binding.statement: The visible handler passes the requested primary-key value to file_response, but the supplied source does not expose the object binding performed inside that call.

control.statement: No authorization predicate or owner-aware view_document check is visible in the supplied handler body; authorization behavior inside file_response is not shown.

effect.statement: If file_response proceeds, the handler returns its response with the attachment disposition, but the supplied entry does not identify the selected file object or establish that it is served.

condition.statement: The visible failure handling only converts FileNotFoundError or Document.DoesNotExist into Http404; it does not expose the authorization outcome for the stated root-owner and version-owner premises.
